description: This file contains Redux Saga generator functions for executing and managing challenge code execution, including building challenge data, running tests, handling previews, and managing challenge lifecycle events in a coding education platform.

methods.name: executeCancellableChallengeSaga
methods.description: Handles the execution of a challenge, including size validation, starting the challenge execution saga, and handling cancellation.

methods.name: executeChallengeSaga
methods.description: Main saga for executing challenge tests, updating console and logs, and handling challenge completion logic.

methods.name: takeEveryConsole
methods.description: Listens to console log channel and updates the UI console output.

methods.name: buildChallengeData
methods.description: Builds challenge data with error handling to disable build on error.

methods.name: executeTests
methods.description: Runs the test runner against provided tests, processes results, and updates console output.

methods.name: previewChallengeSaga
methods.description: Handles previewing challenge code, including building challenge data, updating preview frame or worker, and error handling.

methods.name: updatePreviewSaga
methods.description: Decides whether to update Python challenge or recreate preview based on challenge type.

methods.name: updatePython
methods.description: Builds Python challenge data, interrupts code execution, and runs Python code in worker.

methods.name: previewProjectSolutionSaga
methods.description: Previews project solution if challenge data can be built and has a preview.

methods.name: createExecuteChallengeSaga
methods.description: Creates saga watchers for challenge execution, file updates, and challenge lifecycle events.
